# #04 - DataIngestion Generic (v1.8)

## 版本歷史
- **v1.3 (2026-04-21)** — 改為自動偵測 provider（對齊 #02/#03/#05）：`ollama_embedding_model` 空 → 自動走 Cloud AI `/embeddings`，不再依賴 backend 預先設 `embedding_provider` 旗標
- **v1.2 (2026-04-21)** — 加 `folder_id` 防呆
- **v1.1 (2026-04-21)** — 新增 Cloud AI embedding 備援（IF 依 `embedding_provider` 旗標分流）
- **v1.0 (2026-04-20)** — 初版

**Provider 切換 (v1.3):**
```
Use Ollama Embed? IF ollama_embedding_model notEmpty
  true  → Ollama /api/embed
  false → Cloud AI /embeddings (Bearer cloud_ai_key)
```
`embedding_provider` 變成 Set 節點自動計算並記到 callback 訊息用。

**Trigger:** `POST /webhook/tigerai-step4`

**向量維度注意:** Qdrant collection 的 `vectors.size` 必須匹配所選 embedding model：
- Ollama `qwen3-embedding-8b` → 4096
- OpenAI `text-embedding-3-small` → 1536
- OpenAI `text-embedding-3-large` → 3072

**Input body:**
```json
{
  "folder_path": "/proj_A",
  "collection_name": "labor_law",
  "ollama_url": "http://ollama:11434",
  "ollama_embedding_model": "",          // 空 → 走 cloud
  "cloud_ai_url": "https://api.openai.com/v1",
  "cloud_ai_key": "sk-...",
  "cloud_ai_embedding_model": "text-embedding-3-large",
  "qdrant_url": "http://qdrant-tigerai:6333",
  "qdrant_key": "",
  "backend_url": "http://tigerai-backend:3060"
}
```
- v1.7 (2026-05-24): 地端分支改 OpenAI-compatible /v1/*（通用 ollama/llamacpp/vllm）+ Authorization header
- (2026-05-24): 地端/雲端切換改用 ai_provider 設定（IF 判 ai_provider===local）

--- v1.0.2 2026-05-30: Code -> Set (Build Callback x5 + Build Exclude Request + Build RAG Context, native expressions with .reduce/.map/.filter)

--- v1.0.3 2026-05-30: Deploy-ready cleanup (strip readonly fields, dedupe node names, redirect Sub-Chat-Local->Cloud, sentinel for deploy_n8n.py id-rewire)

--- v1.0.6 2026-05-31: Removed hardcoded URL fallbacks (docling/qdrant/ollama/backend) — backend now ALWAYS sends these in webhook payload. Workflow fails loud if URL missing, no silent container-name drift.
